hypothesis: Blind faults occur adjacent to -- not on -- mapped catalogue traces. A smooth distance-decayed emission kernel peaking ~150 m from known faults targets blind splays/stepovers better than GEMSDOE32 B2's hard >200 m exclusion.
mechanism: Distance-to-catalogue Gaussian bump (peak 1.5 px, sigma 1.0 px) -> per-quadrant top-k dot placement -> binary GeoTIFF, zeros outside footprint.
named_non_fault_mimic: Linear topography / DEM scarp edges unrelated to faults can produce similar distance-from-catalogue structure.
holdout_leakage_note: CAUTION: dot placement used the full catalogue (not per-fold visible faults only), so HOLDOUT-DTI may be inflated by leakage. A proper per-fold evaluation is required before slot promotion.
